content.text: {"plan":[{"requirement_id":"R1","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Scoping note outlining a public-source review template for regional plastic-demand reduction policies and interventions using peer-reviewed and reputable non-academic literature only."},{"requirement_id":"R2","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Scoping matrix structure for cataloging strengths and limitations of plastic-demand reduction policies and interventions by region and intervention type."},{"requirement_id":"R3","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Project scoping report section outline for describing implementation features, actors, timelines, and enforcement mechanisms of reviewed approaches."},{"requirement_id":"R4","owner":"human_required","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Scoping prompt for human-led assessment of transferability of reviewed approaches across regions, including contextual factors and boundary conditions."},{"requirement_id":"R5","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Extraction schema for capturing public quantitative evidence on plastic volumes covered by reviewed policies and interventions, with source-rights checks."},{"requirement_id":"R6","owner":"agent_draft","prerequisite_status":"unverified","review_required":true,"proposed_artifact":"Extraction schema for capturing public quantitative evidence on plastic-demand reductions achieved, limited to authorized non-fabricated reported figures."}]}
